changes.title: Clean-room QuickType word animation
changes.detail: Replace the old outgoing TextView overlay with one bounded, clipped glyph renderer. Shared Latin characters move within their own slot, unrelated suggestions dissolve, and interrupted transitions retarget without rebuilding input targets. Complex scripts, emoji and alternate strip layouts use safe native rendering.

changes.title: Stable confidence capsule and coordinated dividers
changes.detail: The iOS profile keeps the confidence capsule at a fixed slot-based width and coordinates its opacity with the two internal dividers. Previous Default geometry, themes, decoder confidence, dictionaries, touch targets and accessibility remain unchanged. Physical visual acceptance is pending.
